# keychain_internet_password (Resource)

Manages an internet password item in the macOS Keychain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Manage an internet password in the macOS Keychain
resource "keychain_internet_password" "example" {
  server   = "api.example.com"
  account  = "deploy-user"
  protocol = "https"
  password = var.deploy_password

  # Optional attributes
  port                = 443
  path                = "/v1"
  label               = "Example API Credentials"
  authentication_type = "httpBasic"
}

variable "deploy_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

output "server" {
  value = keychain_internet_password.example.server
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account` (String) The account name/username (kSecAttrAccount).
- `password` (String, Sensitive) The password data.
- `protocol` (String) The protocol (http, https, ftp, ssh, smb, afp, ldap, ldaps).
- `server` (String) The server hostname (kSecAttrServer).

### Optional

- `authentication_type` (String) The authentication type (httpBasic, httpDigest, htmlForm, default).
- `label` (String) A human-readable label for the item.
- `path` (String) The URL path.
- `port` (Number) The port number. Defaults to 0 (any port).
- `security_domain` (String) The security domain.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier for this resource (server:account:protocol:port).
